cmd:
set -e
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
git config user.name "weather-odessa-vps"
git config user.email "vps-bot@weather-odessa.local"
TOKEN=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2-)
echo "https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com" > ~/.git-credentials
chmod 600 ~/.git-credentials
git config --global credential.helper store
git remote -v
git log -1 --format="%H %ci"
echo GIT_CONFIG_OK
